hypothesis: At N=256, with best-of-5 controls and checkpoints every 10 steps, the accel_step formation step does not differ from N=64 (steps 100-140) by more than the seed-to-seed spread. This tests the refutation in f-20261011-231210-478d, which the best-of-3 rejudge left resting on one seed.
expected_if_true: All 3 seeds reach accel_step margin >= required_margin at some step in [90, 150], with no seed later than 150. This replicates 'timing roughly fixed across steps_per_orbit' and refutes the 'later at N=256' hypothesis on at least 2 independent seeds.
expected_if_false: At least 2 of 3 seeds first reach required_margin at step >= 160 or never reach it within 300 steps. That would mean N=256 forms accel_step later than N=64, which supports the original task-demand hypothesis.
